indicator_name: Construction price index (total, construction and installation works, machinery and equipment) by region, monthly
description: Индекс цен в строительстве (всего, строительно-монтажные работы, машины и оборудование) по регионам, помесячно
unit: % (previous month = 100 or same month a year earlier = 100)
methodology: Taldau 703045 (total), 703046 (СМР), 703047 (machinery and equipment), period 4, 2011-01 onward. The components have no 2026-07 on Taldau. National 2026-09: TOTAL.MOM 100.4, TOTAL.YOY 110.4. Purchased building materials (703051) have no single total on Taldau and are not kept.
